trust_center.repositoryDescription: Nominal Trust Center: FedRAMP 20x Certification Data (Certification Package Overview, Security Decision Record, Vulnerability Detail and Accepted Vulnerability reports, Significant Change Notifications, Secure Configuration Guide), policies and assessment reports.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Request access at https://trust.nominal.io (name, email, organization and reason). Requests from federal agencies and FedRAMP are approved on the day they are received; approval grants self-service download of every FedRAMP 20x resource and is logged. Questions: fedramp-security@nominal.io.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guide for the Nominal Platform: human-readable guide, machine-readable JSON baseline and use instructions, under the FedRAMP 20x category.
secure_configuration_guidance.accessRequestInstructions: Request access at https://trust.nominal.io (name, email, organization and reason). Requests from federal agencies and FedRAMP are approved on the day they are received; approval grants self-service download of every FedRAMP 20x resource and is logged. Questions: fedramp-security@nominal.io.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Data ingestion, storage, visualization, and analysis for test, telemetry, and mission data: datasets and channels, runs and events, workbooks and dashboards, checks and alerts, and the Nominal API and client libraries, in the GovCloud deployment.

current.service_desc: Cloud platform for aggregating, visualizing, and analyzing test, telemetry, and mission data for hardware and complex systems, operated for U.S. Government customers in a FedRAMP-scoped, government-only AWS GovCloud (US) environment.
